title: Units Claimed on FBN Inbound-Shortage Cases
content:
*Seller Help Center, Fulfilled by Northloop (FBN).*

An inbound-shortage case is the reimbursement case for units of one inbound shipment line that were never received. The claimable shortage of a shipment line is the figure a seller enters as the units claimed when correcting their own open inbound-shortage case.

**Correction period.** The case may be corrected only for a line whose receipt date is at least the inbound reconciliation wait and no more than the inbound shortage claim window before the handling date, both counted in calendar days from the receipt date of that line. Both figures are those of the enrollment's FBN program.

| Calendar days from the line's receipt date to the handling date | Correction possible |
|---|---|
| one day fewer than the inbound reconciliation wait | no |
| exactly the inbound reconciliation wait | yes |
| exactly the inbound shortage claim window | yes |
| one day more than the inbound shortage claim window | no |

## What a correction changes

The correction rewrites the units claimed on the seller's open inbound-shortage case and re-records its loss kind, source references and SKU. The case stays open with its original opening moment, and nothing is approved or paid by the correction.

## The correction tool

**Tool:** `amend_inbound_shortage_claim_fdee09ae`

The seller's own tool: the agent unlocks it and hands it over, and the customer themselves — the seller who owns the case — runs it.

### Parameters

| Parameter | Meaning and format |
|---|---|
| `case_id` | Reference number of the seller's open FBN reimbursement case being corrected, as listed in the seller's case list from the FBN case lookup. |
| `reimbursement_type` | Loss kind recorded on the case; one of `lost_in_warehouse`, `damaged_in_warehouse`, `inbound_shortage` (an inbound shipment line received short), `customer_return_not_received`, `removal_lost`, `not_applicable` (a fee dispute rather than a loss claim). |
| `adjustment_ref` | Inventory adjustment reference the case names, copied from the case record; empty string when it names no single adjustment. |
| `shipment_id` | Inbound shipment number the case names, copied from the case record; empty string when it names no shipment. |
| `order_id` | Marketplace order number the case names, copied from the case record; empty string when it names no order. |
| `removal_order_id` | Removal order reference the case names, copied from the case record; empty string when it names no removal order. |
| `sku` | Seller SKU of the case, copied character for character from the case record, verbatim. |
| `units_claimed` | Corrected number of units the seller claims: a whole number of units, zero or more, no fractional part. |

### Return

A receipt with `case_id`, `sku`, `units_claimed` (the units now claimed) and `case_status`, always `submitted` — the case is still open awaiting a decision. A returned receipt means the correction is recorded; the tool defines no other outcome.
